# Fast Freight AI

> Fast Freight AI (a DBA of ThriveOn Solutions, California) helps freight brokers, factoring companies and trucking insurance agencies win back the opportunities that went quiet: quotes that never got a second follow-up, shippers who said "circle back next quarter", and carrier applications that stalled. We reach back out in the client's voice and book the ones who are still shipping on their calendar. The first 6 weeks are free; after that, clients pay per booked call.

Key idea: freight pipeline recovery is the process of re-engaging quotes, shippers or carrier applications that went quiet, before they're lost to a competitor.

## Playbooks

- [How to Find Shippers as a Freight Broker](https://fast-freight-ai.com/blog/how-to-find-shippers-freight-broker/): a 30-minute audit of quiet quotes, a 0–10 scoring sheet, 7 insider re-engagement plays (routing guide backup, bid calendar, tender rejections, service audits), free prospecting channels, a cold call script and a 30-day plan.

## Free tool

- [Opportunity Leak Check](https://recovery-challenge-prop.netlify.app/): a 90-second check that shows how many opportunities stopped moving before anyone said no.
